snippet.title: Exciting Pioneers of New World Finals | Watch the contestant battle for the $100 Prize Pool
snippet.description:
Welcome to the finals of the second Pioneers of New World community tournament! In this showdown, the four players who successfully won their knockout round matches go head-to-head for a share of the $100 prize pool.

Final Match Details:
🏆 Second Pioneers of New World Community Tournament
💰 Prize Pool: $100
👥 Contestants:
- BeefTestes
- Hastur
- Bouncyknight
- Roasteddoinks

Join the Community:
If you enjoyed this video, make sure to like and subscribe so you don’t miss any future Pioneers of New World tournaments and gameplay! Let us know if you're interested in running a sponsored tournament in our free-to-play online Catan alternative.
